invariants.name: workspace_tenant_isolation
invariants.description: Workspace/tenant data must never cross an authorized workspace boundary.

invariants.name: chatadmin_authority_boundary
invariants.description: ChatAdmin is never Platform Admin, Admin CRM, Billing, Operations or service_role.

invariants.name: no_browser_service_role
invariants.description: Browser/client code must never receive or exercise service_role authority.

invariants.name: no_social_or_onlyfans_auto_send_v1
invariants.description: Social and OnlyFans V1 remain human-send/manual-handoff only unless a separately approved contract supersedes this invariant.

invariants.name: creator_workspace_uniqueness
invariants.description: Normal Creator semantics require creators.workspace_id uniqueness for the ordinary Creator path.

invariants.name: character_context_isolation
invariants.description: Character context must never cross character or workspace boundaries.

invariants.name: payment_activation_gate
invariants.description: No payment or paid-tier activation without satisfied Tax, Billing and Entitlement gates.

invariants.name: no_normal_web_deploy_db_migration
invariants.description: Controlled database migrations must never be applied by the normal Web deploy path.

invariants.name: no_implementation_only_acceptance
invariants.description: Implementation-only evidence can never produce ACCEPTED or PRODUCTION_CONFIRMED.

invariants.name: no_automerge_with_blockers
invariants.description: Auto-merge is forbidden with P1/P2, unresolved review threads, pending required checks or red required checks.

invariants.name: no_rebuild_closed_scope
invariants.description: ACCEPTED, VERIFIED, PRODUCTION_CONFIRMED, SUPERSEDED, FAILED or owner-deferred scope must not be rebuilt without a recorded revalidation/reopen reason.

invariants.name: no_secrets_in_repo_logs_chat
invariants.description: Secrets, passwords, tokens, private keys and raw protected credentials must never enter Git, logs or chat.
